name: Finnmark FD-3 Full Spectrum 4-Person Infrared Sauna
description: Finnmark FD-3 Full Spectrum, 72"W x 46"D x 78"H Indulge in the spacious comfort of Finnmark Design's FD-3 Full-Spectrum Infrared Home Sauna, designed for 3 to 4 people. Elevate your daily routine by transforming your space into a haven of wellness right at home. Finnmark Designs stands apart as the sole infrared sauna manufacturer seamlessly integrating long-wave carbon 360 infrared panels with UL listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This dynamic fusion ensures higher temperatures, complete body coverage, deeper penetration, and an unparalleled sauna experience. Strategically positioned, each heater maximizes therapeutic benefits, reaching a remarkable 170° in under an hour on a standard home outlet—an engineering marvel. Immerse yourself in the natural goodness of antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar, guarding against mold, bacteria, and fungus for a sauna that's not just warm but consistently fresh. Complemented by the enduring Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior, resistant to rot, warp, decay, or chipping, Finnmark Designs' full spectrum infrared saunas epitomize durability and longevity. Redefine relaxation with a touch of innovation—this is the essence of Finnmark. Features Antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar interior that protects against mold, bacteria, and fungus. Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior that will never rot, warp, decay or chip. Making Finnmark Designs full spectrum infrared saunas one of the healthiest and longest lasting saunas on the market. Finnmark Designs is the only infrared sauna manufacturer that combines long-wave carbon 360 infrared panels with UL listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration and an experience better than any other sauna. Each heater is strategically placed to offer the highest level of therapy possible. Built-in LCD touchscreen controller with Bluetooth audio. Audio with 6" HiFi speakers, 8mm tempered glass for the ultimate thermal retention. Ergonomic backrest for comfort Removable and adjustable sauna feet for uneven surfaces. Low EMF sauna tested by a NASA award winning testing facility. High Emissivity infrared heaters High quality double walled construction with non-toxic wool insulation. Over 15,000 Sold Health Benefits Benefits of Infrared The technology of the Spectrum Plus incoloy heaters warms your core body temperature, producing a cleaner, healthier sweat while lowering blood pressure, and maintaining heart health. The natural heat produced by the Spectrum Plus heaters is designed to achieve a more controlled hot climate much like a traditional sauna without the unbearable heat temperatures. This deeper penetration through sweating goes beyond the muscle and fat rather than a traditional or hot air sauna. As a result, you're able to work up the best possible sweat in the least amount of time. Spectrum Plus heaters remove 17% more toxins such as cholesterol, fat-soluble toxins, toxic heavy metals, sulfuric acid, sodium, ammonia, and uric acid. Full Spectrum Sauna combination of long-wave Spectrum Carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration, and a better experience than any other sauna. Reap the benefits of a more natural pain relief remedy with every infrared sauna session. Athletes can appreciate a faster muscle recovery with increased blood flow to the muscles, delivering more concentrated oxygen and creating more energy to heal.
